name: Mathematics
notes: Foundational courses must be completed before acceptance into the minor.

Equivalent substitutions the page allows: MATH 163 for MATH 165; MATH 171/172/174 for MATH 161/162/164; MATH 173 for MATH 165; MATH 141-143 for MATH 161-162. The calculus sequence alternatives are handled by the app's calc-sequence equivalency group; the MATH 163 / 173 substitutions for MATH 165 are modeled as options.
AP credit may satisfy foundational requirements. MATH 150A may NOT be used for foundational requirements.
MATH 235 may instead be satisfied by MATH 173.
An advanced course is any mathematics course numbered 200 or above except MATH 235.

requirementGroups.label: Foundational calculus
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 161: Calculus IA; MATH 162: Calculus IIA ... Equivalent courses can be substituted: MATH 171, 172, and 174 for the equivalent MATH 161, 162, and 164; MATH 141-143 for MATH 161-162

requirementGroups.label: Linear algebra with differential equations
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 165: Linear Algebra with Differential Equations ... MATH 163 for MATH 165 ... MATH 173 for MATH 165

requirementGroups.label: Discrete mathematics or multidimensional calculus
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following: MATH 150: Discrete Mathematics; MATH 164: Multidimensional Calculus. Equivalent courses can be substituted: MATH 171, 172, and 174 for the equivalent MATH 161, 162, and 164. Math 150A may not be used to satisfy foundational requirements.

requirementGroups.label: Linear algebra (MATH 235)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 235: Linear Algebra. The requirement that MATH 235 be taken can also be satisfied by completing MATH 173.

requirementGroups.label: Advanced mathematics courses (2)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two 4-credit advanced mathematics courses. Any mathematics course numbered 200 or above (except MATH 235) qualifies as an advanced mathematics course.
